name: J-STAGE — Japan Science and Technology Agency journal platform
notes: Japan's national journal platform (JST): 4,514 titles, ~6.09M articles of which ~5.88M free/open. Registry-only for now: the article search is a JavaScript-built multi-row form — plain GET probes of the search endpoint answered HTTP 500 / an error redirect from the build sandbox on 2026-11-26, and no public API or OAI route is offered; its articles remain reachable via Crossref/DOAJ.

name: SciOpen — Tsinghua University Press open-access platform (China)
notes: Open-access publishing platform of Tsinghua University Press hosting Chinese and international journals, free full text. Registry-only for now: the site is a JavaScript single-page app and /search answered a 404 shell from the build sandbox on 2026-11-26, so no machine-usable search route could be verified live.

name: COAJ — China Open Access Journals
notes: Non-profit database of Chinese open-access journals (China Science Publishing & Media): 341 Chinese journals, 90,000+ articles (end of 2025). Registry-only for now: the homepage is a JavaScript app shell with no server-rendered search form and /search answered HTTP 401 from the build sandbox on 2026-11-26.

name: KoreaScience — Korean Federation of Science and Technology Societies platform
notes: Platform of the Korean Federation of Science and Technology Societies (KOFST): hundreds of Korean society journals, open-access full text, alongside the national KCI index. Registry-only for now: the site and article pages answer, but the search is JavaScript-driven and every candidate search route probed on 2026-11-26 answered 404 or timed out, so no machine-usable keyword route could be verified live.

name: MongoliaJOL — Mongolia Journals Online
notes: Mongolian member of the Journals Online family (INASP/Ubiquity), free to view and search. Live search wired in build_article.py (search_asian_platforms) via the OJS site-wide search (probed 2026-11-26: 20 result blocks for a test query).

name: NOPR — NIScPR Online Periodicals Repository (India)
notes: Repository of CSIR-NIScPR (India): free full text of 19 research journals, ~61,000 records (DSpace). Registry-only for now: the server closed every connection from the build sandbox during the 2026-11-26 probe (simple-search, discover and the DSpace REST API all dropped), so no search route could be verified live.

name: PakMediNet — Medical Journals of Pakistan
notes: Index of Pakistan's medical journals with HEC/PMDC categories; Pakistan has no single national journal platform. Registry-only for now: the site answered HTTP 403 'Your request was blocked' from the build sandbox on 2026-11-26.

name: HEC Recognised Journals List — Higher Education Commission (Pakistan)
notes: Official list of HEC-recognised Pakistani journals (W/X/Y/Z categories, published as documents on hec.gov.pk). A credibility list, not a searchable article platform; most listed journals are open-access OJS sites reached individually.

name: BanglaJOL — Bangladesh Journals Online
notes: Bangladeshi member of the Journals Online family (INASP/Ubiquity); all material free to view, search and browse. Registry-only under Jupiter's full-text-only law (2026-11-26): the OJS site-wide search answered with real results during the 2026-11-26 probe, but a returned item's full text (OJS galley PDF) could NOT be verified reachable — galley downloads repeatedly timed out / dropped connections from the probe sandbox — so the search route is not wired live until a probe confirms its PDFs. Routes tried: OJS site search, article view pages, galley view and /article/download/<id>/<galley> for two articles.

name: NepJOL — Nepal Journals Online
notes: Nepalese member of the Journals Online family (INASP/Ubiquity), the largest JOL (about 45% of the family's 695 journals); abstracts and mostly full text free. Live search wired in build_article.py (search_asian_platforms) via the OJS site-wide search (probed 2026-11-26: 25 result blocks for a test query).

name: SLJOL — Sri Lanka Journals Online
notes: Sri Lankan member of the Journals Online family (INASP/Ubiquity); ~97% of articles full text. Registry-only for now: the OJS search answered HTTP 403 Forbidden from the build sandbox on 2026-11-26 (both probes), so no search route could be verified live.

name: GARUDA — Garba Rujukan Digital (Indonesia)
notes: Indonesia's national reference portal (Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Technology): thousands of Indonesian journals under the SINTA accreditation system, full text via the publisher. Live search wired in build_article.py (search_asian_platforms) via the documents search (probed 2026-11-26: real article items with titles, authors and source lines).

name: ThaiJO — Thai Journals Online (TCI)
notes: Central journal platform of the Thai-Journal Citation Index Centre (TCI); Thai journals are hosted on per-journal OJS instances and TCI ranks ~1,000 titles (Tier 1-3). Registry-only for now: the portal itself is a JavaScript single-page app and no single site-wide search endpoint answered from the build sandbox on 2026-11-26.

name: VJOL — Vietnam Journals Online
notes: Vietnam's national journal aggregation platform (NASTIS, Ministry of Science and Technology), several hundred journals. The official domain is vjol.info.vn ONLY (vjol.info is unrelated). Live search wired in build_article.py (search_asian_platforms) via the OJS site-wide search (probed 2026-11-26: 25 result blocks for a test query).

name: PhilJOL — Philippine Journals Online
notes: Philippine member of the Journals Online family (INASP/Ubiquity). Registry-only for now: the server closed every connection from the build sandbox during the 2026-11-26 probe, so its OJS search route could not be verified live (its JOL siblings BanglaJOL/NepJOL/MongoliaJOL are wired).

name: MyJurnal — Malaysian Citation Centre platform
notes: Platform of the Citation and Infometrics Centre (Ministry of Higher Education, Malaysia) collecting and indexing all Malaysian journals; full text free where copyright permits. Registry-only for now: the server closed every connection from the build sandbox during the 2026-11-26 probe, so no search route could be verified live.

name: National Academy of Sciences of Kazakhstan — Academy journals
notes: Journal platform of the National Academy of Sciences of Kazakhstan (Bulletin and News series across all fields, OJS, trilingual); Kazakhstan has no single unified journals portal — the Academy list also sits at qazscience.gov.kz. Live search wired in build_article.py (search_asian_platforms) via the OJS site-wide search (probed 2026-11-26: real result blocks).

name: National Academy of Sciences of Tajikistan — Academy periodicals
notes: Periodicals of the National Academy of Sciences of Tajikistan (Reports and News of the Academy in four departments); the VAK journal list is at journals.vak.tj. Registry-only: both are static journal-listing sites with no article search, Tajikistan has no DOAJ-indexed journals and its open access is weak (some full texts sit on eLIBRARY.RU, which is subscription-based and excluded).

name: DergiPark — TÜBİTAK ULAKBİM national journal platform (Turkey)
notes: Turkey's national journal platform (TÜBİTAK ULAKBİM): 3,000+ journals, 800,000+ articles, free full text. Registry-only for search: the web search redirects to a human-verification page, and the public OAI-PMH endpoint (in the api field) answers but is harvest-only, not keyword search — both probed 2026-11-26.

name: SID — Scientific Information Database (Iran)
notes: Iran's open-access scientific information database (ACECR): free full text of approved Iranian journals from 2000 to today. Registry-only for now: home and search pages answered a Cloudflare static-challenge page from the build sandbox on 2026-11-26, so no machine-usable search route could be verified live.

name: MSRT Journals Portal — Ministry of Science, Research and Technology (Iran)
notes: Official portal and ranking list of Iranian scientific journals approved by the Ministry of Science, Research and Technology. A credibility list only — it carries no article full text itself (Iranian full text sits on SID and the journals' own OJS sites).

name: CyberLeninka — Russian open-access scientific library
notes: The largest Russian-language open-access scholarly library: thousands of journals from Russia and the post-Soviet states (incl. Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Ukraine, Belarus), millions of CC BY full-text articles, no registration. Registry-only for search: the search UI is a JavaScript app whose /api/search endpoint rejected every plain probe on 2026-11-26 (GET 405, form POST 400), and the OAI-PMH endpoint (in the api field) answers but is harvest-only, not keyword search.

name: IranJournals / MSRT national journals portal (Iran)
notes: REGISTRY-ONLY (§70 probe 2026-11-27): the ministry's national journals portal. The live Iranian journal system is the per-journal Yektaweb subdomains (e.g. mct.iranjournals.ir), already LIVE-wired per journal (§36/§37); the apex portal itself offers no article search. Routes tried: (1) https://iranjournals.ir/ and https://www.iranjournals.ir/ — no answer from the build sandbox (empty reply); (2) http://iranjournals.ir/ — HTTP 200 but a Sinaweb placeholder page ('Please contact sinaweb to activate this domain'), no search and no records; (3) https://journals.msrt.ir/ (the ministry portal host) — no answer from the sandbox; (4) /sitemap.xml on the apex — no answer. No machine search + reachable full text exists at the portal level, so it stays registry-only under the full-text-only law; journal-level coverage flows through the §37 wired subdomains (probe 2026-11-27: the §37 MCT route returns Keramati 1404, 'نگاه دانشوران کهن به مسئلهٔ دقت در محاسبه و اندازه‌گیری', with a direct PDF, %PDF- magic verified).
